desc:
💪 Train your arms, grow LONGER, and FLING yourself down the rainbow track! Fly farther and earn more Wins! 🏆

🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT 🎃
👻 Complete quests, fly, and battle Bosses for event XP
🎁 Progress through 100 event levels for rewards
🍬 Collect tokens for prize draws and the event shop
📅 Check in daily for extra rewards!

🔥 FEATURES 🔥
💪 Train to boost Power and arm length
🚀 Launch across the rainbow track
🏆 Unlock new arms and equipment with Wins
🐾 Hatch pets to boost your training
🔄 Rebirth for multipliers and diamonds
🌍 Explore Meadow 🌿, Frost ❄️, and Lava 🌋
🎁 Daily, online, and offline rewards

Can you grow the LONGEST arms? 👀

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!
🔔 Join the group for exclusive rewards!
